name: Zluri
summary: Zluri is a SaaS management platform that builds its app inventory from single sign-on, device management, CASB and direct API connections. It monitors activity to find unused licenses and sends renewal alerts from a contract record. Prices are quoted after a demo.

facts.text: Zluri says its discovery engine pulls from SSO systems, mobile device management tools, CASBs and local devices, and that it reveals apps outside SSO coverage.
Zluri cites 300+ direct API integrations and a catalog of 239K+ apps.
Zluri says it can auto-reclaim or downgrade licenses based on usage thresholds and sends software renewal alerts.
Zluri's FAQ states compliance with GDPR, NIST, SOC 2 Type II, PCI-DSS, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 27701.

plans.name: SaaS Management Platform
plans.notes: No price published. The only call to action is a demo request.
